visualCharacteristics.structure: date + author image + name + role + email + phone + tags + share icons

contentPattern: One row with 2 cells: author headshot image | author name (p, strong), role (p), email (mailto link), phone (tel link). Date, tags and read time are NOT authored in the block. The block JS reads them from page metadata (publication-date, tags/keywords, read-time). The bookmark, Facebook and LinkedIn share actions are generated by the block JS from the page URL, not authored.
